type: Built React workbench and real domain-script integration in jsdom with mocked fetch

checks.name: Idle, typed edits, navigation, notes and theme controls never POST or poll a model
Scope selector covers each scene/background/instance, all 21 definitions and all 38 behaviors
Notes stay scoped through switches, panel close, domain edits and page reload
Explicit Submit freezes one authenticated snapshot with thread/base revision and blocks double clicks
Empty unchanged draft is rejected locally; typed-only changes can be explicitly submitted
Offline startup keeps browser editing usable and explicit refresh restores the connection
Uncertain POST blocks retries until refresh verifies no receipt; refresh never auto-resubmits
A lost POST response recovers the accepted exact-ID receipt without resubmission
Changing durable store or thread cannot clear an unresolved envelope; restoring the original mapping can
Unavailable recovery storage prevents POST instead of losing the immutable recovery envelope
Stale source baseline disables submission until a refreshed adapter match is verified
Polling interruption keeps a known receipt visible and refresh can recover without duplicate POST
HTTP conflict reconciles to another-tab receipt and uses its updated base revision only on the next Submit
Reload restores an active receipt, polls to failure and preserves notes without issuing any POST

limitations: No rendered-browser visual/accessibility claim, real network, Codex inference, or source-writeback claim.
